scope: all v2 retained primary masks and their frozen persistent identities
same_identity_aliases: erode each accepted member mask then union, count each frame once
core: largest erosion radius 10 down to 1 giving max(20,ceil(0.2*seed projected unique points)); preserve existing core claims; conflicts ambiguous
support: depth-visible TSDF reverse projection into accepted mask; frozen forward vote projection unchanged
cross_target_growth: simultaneous claims, different IDs ambiguous, remove ambiguous bridges then reconnect to core
history: retained original sampled source observations only; same visible point relabel to unique confirmed region identity, unrestricted historical IDs
SAM2_and_mask_gate: same V2 gate applied to new SAM2.1 tracks
final_commit: only points with aggregate vote counts changed vs control
